title: Birchwood Court, Northwood Avenue, Santry, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: Birchwood Court, Northwood Avenue, Santry, Co. Dublin
description:
**** Stunning Development of Newly Built Studios, One, Two and Three-Bedroom Apartments ****  

Storyhouse is proud to introduce Birchwood Court, a brand new development of attractive apartments located in the popular Northwood area in Dublin 9.

This new development comprises a wide selection of Studios, One, Two and Three bedroom apartments all beautifully finished, fully furnished and ready for move in, with on-site amenities including a gym, co-working space and more.  These stylish, generously proportioned new apartments offer perfect convenience in a popular location, situated just off the M50 and just a 10 minute drive to Dublin Airport.  

With Dublin City Centre on your doorstep with numerous bus routes and just 3 minutes from the M50, Birchwood Court is a great choice for all and offers many local amenities such as creches, schools, supermarkets and Gulliver's Retail Park, which is adjacent to the development and houses a large Lidl alongside many other retailers.

**Due to the high volumes of interest in this development unfortunately it may not be possible to respond to every enquiry**


NOTE: There are multiple unit types available in this development. The marketing material may not be of the exact unit available but are representative of the development rather than the exact specifications of the individual unit. The rent advertised represents the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific unit type. The overall BER Rating at this development is A Rated**
